headline: Stonecradle and Nevish Line Erupt as Fighting Shifts Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, combat has surged violently in Stonecradle, which recorded seven base events over the past two hours amidst mounting casualties at The Reach and The Dais, reducing one strategic position to no-man's-land. Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line have likewise reignited; Linn of Mercy logged three base contests at Lathair with rapidly accelerating losses, while Nevish Line registered four recent exchanges and heavy attrition around Princefal. Weathered Expanse remains a brutal battleground, logging five base shifts and over thirty-one hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour span. Conversely, the tempestuous struggles in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County have cooled substantially in tempo despite lingering skirmishes. Sectors such as Viper Pit, Fisherman's Row, and Stlican Shelf have subsided into relative quiet, though Dead Lands shows a sharp acceleration in casualty rates without immediate territorial changes.
